mapper.sql: id, reg_no, patient_id, patient_name, doctor_code, doctor_name, dept_code, dept_name, schedule_id, work_date, period, queue_no, fee, room, status, chief_complaint, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_registration (reg_no, patient_id, patient_name, doctor_code, doctor_name, dept_code, dept_name, schedule_id, work_date, period, queue_no, fee, room, status, chief_complaint, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{regNo}, #{patientId}, #{patientName}, #{doctorCode}, #{doctorName}, #{deptCode}, #{deptName}, #{scheduleId}, #{workDate}, #{period}, #{queueNo}, #{fee}, #{room}, #{status}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_registration SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_registration SET remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(queue_no), 0) FROM t_registration WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}

SELECT dept_code AS deptCode, dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(1) AS regCount FROM t_registration
AND work_date = #{workDate}
AND status IN (0, 1, 2)
GROUP BY dept_code, dept_name ORDER BY regCount DESC
